description: This Dart source file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter application. It constructs a scaffold with an app bar containing a title, notification button, and user avatar. The body features a continue learning card, progress information, and a grid of course cards, each with tap interactions that trigger snackbars. It references external widgets like ContinueLearningCard, CourseCard, and AvatarSquare, and external data sampleCourses.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the main dashboard screen with a header, continue learning section, progress info, and a grid of popular courses.

methods.name: _showSnack
methods.description: Displays a SnackBar with the given message; called upon tapping notification icon, profile avatar, and course cards.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including app bar and body with various sections.
